Name: Burton Leonard circular
Description: Across farmland to South Stainley, onto the Ripon Rowel path, and back via Copgrove. There is roadside parking in the village.

Name: Ripon Canal
Description: A stretch of towpath beside the Ripon Canal, with boats, birds and no traffic.

Name: Ripon Rowel Walk, first leg
Description: Ripon Minster to South Stainley along the canal, the River Ure at Oxclose Lock and Bishop Monkton, then through Burton Leonard past the village green. One way; the No. 36 bus runs back to Ripon.

Name: Nidderdale Classic
Description: A ride recorded by Dave. Mostly gravel track with some quiet lanes, four proper climbs and a high point of 440 m. Good fitness needed.

Name: Ferrensby, Knaresborough and Ripley
Description: A mountain bike ride recorded by Dave. Mostly tarmac and cycleway, with some singletrack and gravel. Can be muddy in places.
